name: What preparations should I make before ceiling repair technicians arrive?

mainEntity.name: What preparations should I make before ceiling repair technicians arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before ceiling repair technicians from Maine Results, Inc. arrive, you should clear the work area of furniture, wall decorations, and any fragile items to prevent damage and provide unobstructed access. Covering remaining large furniture and flooring with drop cloths is also advisable to protect them from dust and debris. If the repair involves a light fixture or ceiling fan, consider carefully removing it if you are comfortable doing so, or discuss it with the technicians beforehand. This preparation helps the team work efficiently and protects your belongings.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before technicians arrive, clear furniture and fragile items from the work area, cover remaining items, and consider removing light fixtures if comfortable.
